title: File:Lone Star BBQ Santee South Carolina 2009 - 1.jpg
author: anoldent
description: The Lone Star Barbecue & Mercantile is located in Santee, SC. It's constructed of four, old country general stores, which the restaurant's owner purchased, moved to this location, and connected with short passage ways.
